dimensionReasons.reason: Full-fibre broadband and Wi-Fi services align with Cudy CPE use cases, but this is an ISP rather than a retail account.
The ISP can influence subscriber equipment but does not evidence third-party consumer retail purchasing.
More than 300,000 London residents and businesses demonstrate substantial ISP scale outside the requested peer group.
A live fibre network, account support and bundled broadband services show mature operator execution.
The company may be an ISP prospect in another task, but role mismatch is a hard blocker for retail evaluation.

unsupportedOrContradictoryClaims: No evidence establishes Community Fibre as a retailer or e-tailer.
